seo_title: Patreon Downloader - Browser Extension for Saving Patreon Content
seo_description: Download supported Patreon videos, audio posts, images, post text, and attachments from content you can already access.
name: Patreon Downloader
tagline: Download Patreon videos, audio, images, post text, and attachments for offline access
description: Patreon Downloader is a browser extension that helps users save supported videos, audio posts, images, post text, and attachments from Patreon content they can already access.
installation_instructions:
1. Open the latest release: https://github.com/serpapps/patreon-downloader/releases/latest
2. Download the extension build for your browser
3. Install the extension
4. Open Patreon and sign in
5. Use the extension popup or in-page button on supported posts
usage_instructions: Open Patreon in the browser where the extension is installed
Sign in to the Patreon account with access to the post
Press play for video or audio content if needed
Open the extension popup or use the in-page button
Select the detected media and start the download
